items.title: Frank Wess interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: Frank was interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods on May 29, 1995 aboard a jazz cruise in the Caribbean.

ctx.x: After the Basie years he found steady work in New York studios while keeping a presence on the jazz scene with the New York Jazz Quartet and Dameronia. In recent years, Frank has co-led a group with Frank Foster, performed briefly with Woody Herman and has become a featured player at jazz fests and parties across the country.
Frank was interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods on May 29, 1995 aboard a jazz cruise in the Caribbean.
We are on board the Royal Caribbean cruise line and we are filming the Jazz Archive series for Hamilton College. Our guest today is Frank Wess. Pleased to have you.
